faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about modernizing your rental operations.
faq.q1: Is the QR digital signature legally binding?
faq.a1: Yes, our platform generates legally binding electronic signatures that meet international standards for rental agreements.
faq.q2: Do I need to install GPS hardware?
faq.a2: We support professional hardware like Teltonika for real-time tracking, but you can also manage mileage manually if preferred.
faq.a3: Absolutely. KimiFleet is built for multi-branch agencies with centralized administration.
faq.q4: How secure is our agency data?
faq.a4: We use multi-tenant architecture to ensure every agency's data is isolated and encrypted at the highest standards.
faq.q5: Can I migrate from my current spreadsheets?
faq.a5: Yes, we offer bulk import tools to get your entire fleet online in a matter of minutes.
faq.a6: Our financial module allows you to record partial and full payments, syncing them directly with your rental records and invoices.
